sampleTranscript:
Interviewer: Walk me through the incident timeline from first alert to mitigation.
Jesse: We saw elevated error rates at 09:14, isolated the bad deploy by 09:21, and restored service by 09:29.
Interviewer: What would you change to make the rollback faster next time?
Jesse: I would pre-stage the previous artifact and tighten the canary threshold so the bad release trips automatically.
Interviewer: Capture the follow-up action items and owners before we close.
Jesse: Action item one is deployment guardrails with Priya, action item two is alert tuning with Marco, and action item three is a rollback drill this Friday.
